title: PolicySignal v1
description: Distinguishes ADVISORY signals (reasoning, recommendations, estimated risk -- from IVE, Evidence & Trust, Quant, or anywhere else) from AUTHORITATIVE policy decisions, which only a small, explicit allow-list of sources may produce (Section 13). This is horizontal -- the same rule applies regardless of which domain produced the signal.

source.description: Dot-namespaced component identity, e.g. 'ive.reasoning', 'aef.policy_engine', 'evidence_trust.legal_gate'. validators.ts enforces: any source in the IVE namespace (or any namespace not on the explicit AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_ALLOWLIST) claiming kind=AUTHORITATIVE is REJECTED outright, regardless of signal content.

signal.description: The actual content, e.g. 'recommended_risk_level: low' or 'policy_decision: DENY'. Free text at the schema level -- authority is determined by kind+source, never by parsing this string.

request_ref.description: Optional reference to the ExecutionRequest this signal concerns.
